Package hu.bme.mit.theta.analysis.algorithm.mdd.node.expression

Interface MddValues

All Known Implementing Classes:
SymbolicValues
public interface MddValues
How the keys of a diagram stand for values and how a step acts on its terminals, attached to the graph. The plain values key literals and leave the terminals alone; SymbolicValues also key a token whose value a formula in the terminal constrains.
